reason: Two queued waiters fired on the same sentinel file and ran this unit concurrently. One process reported success (43.0 s) and the other crashed on a FileExistsError while creating fitted/utility/A/income_binary/logistic.
disposition: Unit invalidated and preserved unchanged. It is NOT used in any table. Re-run cleanly by a single process. No artifact from this directory is averaged, merged or voted with the replacement.
precedent: The completed transport study saw the same failure mode: three Mode B units aborted on concurrent writes/reads of one release file (its lock amendment 1).
cause: Orchestration error in this session, not a defect in the pipeline code.
operator_fix: Only one runner at a time; waiters are no longer duplicated on one sentinel.
